title: Renewal Premium Increase Alert
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeinsurance:renewal renewal_premium_usd=* prior_premium_usd=*
| eval increase_pct=round(100*(renewal_premium_usd-prior_premium_usd)/nullif(prior_premium_usd,0),1)
| where increase_pct>=10
| sort - increase_pct
| table policy_id renewal_premium_usd prior_premium_usd increase_pct days_until_renewal
description: Flags home insurance renewals where the quoted premium rose ten percent or more versus the prior term.
value: Renewal shock is easier to negotiate when you see the percentage jump before the auto-pay date hits.
implementation: Include `prior_premium_usd` and `renewal_premium_usd` on each renewal export and review increases sixty days ahead.
visualization: Table of policies sorted by renewal premium increase percent.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when your home insurance renewal quote jumped noticeably compared with last year.
